description: Mock Mode — Developer/QA tool that replays 2025 NHL Playoff data offline via VITE_MOCK_MODE env var, enabling mock drafts with AI bots, day-by-day and round-by-round simulation, and full playoff season testing without Supabase or NHL API dependencies

userStories.title: Write fixture data download script
userStories.description: As a developer, I want an automated script that downloads 2025 NHL Playoff data from the NHL API and generates TypeScript fixture files, so the data is reproducible.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/mock-data/src/scripts/download.ts that uses @sportsnot/nhl-api functions to fetch data

Script pipeline: 1) getPlayoffBracket('20242025') for teams+series, 2) getTeamRoster(abbr, '20242025') x16 teams, 3) getPlayoffSchedule('20242025') for all games, 4) getPlayerGameLog(id, '20242025', 3) for all players, 5) optionally getGameBoxscore(id) for goalie enrichment
Script includes rate limiting (max 10 concurrent requests, 100ms delay between batches)

Script writes TypeScript files with 'export const' and 'as const' into packages/mock-data/src/data/: teams.ts, players.ts, bracket.ts, games-r1.ts, games-r2.ts, games-cf.ts, games-scf.ts, player-game-logs.ts
Script logs progress (e.g., 'Fetching roster for TBL... done (23 players)')
Script handles API errors gracefully (retry transient failures, log and skip missing data)
Script is idempotent — running again overwrites existing fixture files
Register an Nx 'download' target in packages/mock-data/project.json that runs the script (e.g., via tsx)
Create packages/mock-data/README.md documenting how to run 'nx download mock-data' and what it produces
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Unit tests pass
Playwright tests pass
userStories.notes: Use the existing @sportsnot/nhl-api package functions — do NOT duplicate API logic. The NHL API season format is '20242025'. Playoff gameType is 3. The script writes .ts files, not .json. Generated fixture files will be committed to the repo.

userStories.title: Day-by-day simulation state machine
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the ADVANCE_DAY and ADVANCE_ROUND reducer actions to work so that simulation state progresses through the 2025 playoff calendar.
acceptanceCriteria: ADVANCE_DAY action in the reducer increments simulationDate by one calendar day
After advancing a day, cumulative player stats are recalculated by summing all per-game stats from player-game-logs.ts where gameDate <= simulationDate
Stat accumulation is a pure function: (fixtures, currentDate) => cumulativeStats map keyed by player ID
Each round's games define a firstDate and lastDate boundary — when simulationDate >= lastDate for the current round, a 'roundComplete' flag is set to true in state
ADVANCE_ROUND action increments currentRound (1->2->3->4), sets simulationDate to the day before the next round's first game, and resets roundComplete to false
ADVANCE_ROUND is only valid when roundComplete is true (reducer ignores it otherwise)
When currentRound is 4 and roundComplete is true, a 'seasonComplete' flag is set
RESET_ALL resets simulationDate to the day before R1 game 1, currentRound to 1, and clears all cumulative stats
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Unit tests pass
Playwright tests pass
userStories.notes: The initial simulationDate after draft should be the day before the first R1 game in the fixture data. The stat accumulation function should handle both skater stats (NHLPlayerStats) and goalie stats.
